ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution covering ~92% of the visible fluke, with approximately 8% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters scattered as focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black pigmentation field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white circular blobs (2-12 pixels in diameter) are concentrated in a cluster on the mid-left lobe and dispersed along the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetric V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees at the medial intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; peak-to-valley depths vary between 5 and 20 pixels. The right lobe inner boundary exhibits more pronounced, jagged indentations compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges of both lobes, terminating in acute tips; right tip shows a secondary posterior-oriented hook-like contour.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent spatial detection of white circular pixel clusters (diameter 3-10 pixels) localized to the interior left lobe and the peripheral boundaries of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and traumatic indentations along the trailing edge boundaries; extensive white rosette-style circular scars across the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: A deep, secondary notch-like indentation is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch.
